main_text.p: 3. Doctrinam verò Jesuitarū, quam Anthonius Sanctarellus in peculiari tractatu de hærefi & potestate summi Pontificis conscripsit, Theologi Parisienses condemnarunt veluti exitialem & pestilentem meritoq; damnandam, aversandam, detegstandam & abhorrendam, cum sit nova, falsa erronea, verbo Dei contraria, pacis publicæ perturbativa, Regnorum, Statuum, rerumq; publicarum eversiva, subditos ab obedientia & subiectione avocans, & ad factiones, rebelliones, seditiones & Principum parricidia excitans.
Animadvertis ne Lector, quomodo Harscherus festucam videritin oculis nostris, trabem autem non viderit in oculo suo? Sed hoc Hypocritarum est ut Christus docet,

page.notes: Printed text in the scan reads "Harscherus festucam viderit" with a stray stop; "detegstandam" as printed. Several words are slightly blurred; the catchword is "CON" in the lower right corner.
